content.short: Wallet 3 is an open-source, Ethereum-based multi-chain wallet that supports Layer-2 and EVM-compatible chains.
content.description: Wallet 3 is an open-source, EVM-based wallet that supports Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, and other EVM-compatible networks. As a true multi-chain solution, it encompasses Layer-2 solutions and other compatible chains, delivering a unified experience across diverse networks. The project is led by a technically focused team with extensive experience from initiatives such as Chainbow, Dagen, and Note SV, aiming to provide transparent, flexible wallet capabilities for developers and users alike.
